text: 你们扭打成一团，拳打脚踢，膝撞肘击。你用头撞向他的头，额头砸中他的鼻子，显然把鼻梁打断了。他本能地捂住脸，枪掉在地上。
你毫不犹豫地抓起枪朝他开火，知道如果情况反过来，他也会这么做。子弹击穿约书亚的胸口，他脸上满是震惊。
他脸色煞白，手无力地抓着你的衣服。他似乎无法接受你竟敢杀他。他死去时深深凝视着你的眼睛，发出一些奇怪的声音，连一个濒死之人都不该发出这样的声音。你觉得自己几乎听见了话语，但确信那只是自己的幻觉。他用最后一口气吐出那句话：“Bokrug ron ‘bthnk n’ghft, ‘ai。”
他的手软了下去。你把尸体从身上推开，忍不住打了个寒战。鼓起勇气后，你检查他的口袋，找到钥匙和身份证件，从而得知他的住处。你可以去他家寻找线索，也可以继续寻找阿米莉娅。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 143
text: You roll over one another, punching and kicking and kneeing and elbowing. You slam your head into his, smashing your forehead against his nose, clearly breaking it. He reflexively grabs at his face and drops the gun.
Without hesitation, you seize the weapon and fire into him, knowing he would do the same if the circumstances were reversed. The look on Joshua’s face is utter shock as the bullet pierces his chest.

The color drains from his face, and his hand weakly grips at your clothes. He looks offended that you would dare to kill him. He stares deep into your eyes as he dies, uttering strange sounds, the likes of which not even a dying man should make. You fancy that you almost hear words, though you’re sure it’s only your mind playing tricks on you. With his last breath, he utters the phrase: “Bokrug ron ‘bthnk n’ghft, ‘ai.”

His hand goes limp. You push the corpse off you, shuddering as you do so. Mustering your courage, you check his pockets for keys and ID, which reveals his place of residence. You could make your way to his house to search for clues, or you could continue on in search of Amelia.
